verdict.rationale: The evidence confirms a first-party Unity Editor with an inspector and Editor Windows that users can extend with custom inspectors and property drawers (unity-docs-10, unity-docs-30). It also describes scene-centric, real-time 3D authoring in that editor (unity-docs-5, unity-docs-18, unity-docs-9). However, nothing in the pack explicitly documents a scene viewport, the prefab system, or level composition as the primary workflow, so only part of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit scene view/viewport documentation, prefab and scene-composition documentation, level-building workflow docs, independent or hands-on corroboration from technical artists.
